 Cyberpunk 2 Multiplayer Looks Likely 
 by Cpt.Jank 
 Yesterday, 12:02
 Discuss (15 Comments) 
 Cyberpunk 2 has already been confirmed as being in development by CD Projekt Red, but not all that much has been revealed about the game aside from its massive budget and a potential 2030 launch date . Now, a new job posting by CD Projekt Red has potentially confirmed recent rumors that multiplayer support is being worked on for Cyberpunk 2 . This comes after Cyberpunk 2077 was originally meant to have multiplayer support, but that was cancelled ahead of release. 
The job listing is for a lead quest programmer "to join the team working on Cyberpunk 2" and specifically mentions "understanding of multiplayer network architecture and client-server synchronization for game state/quests" in the "nice to have" section. This suggests that, while multiplayer is almost certainly on the cards for Cyberpunk 2, the game will still likely be built with the single-player, narrative-driven gameplay first and foremost—perhaps something similar to the older Borderlands games, whose campaigns can be played in multiplayer or single-player, all within the same playthrough. The full requirements for the Cyberpunk 2 Lead Quest Designer read as follows: Qualifications At least 7 years of professional programming experience within the AAA games industry.
 1+ years experience in technical leadership, people management, or leading a team of engineers.
 Strong proficiency in C++ programming.
 Demonstrated experience developing custom quest systems, narrative tools, or node-based editor workflows.
 Proven track record of working in a highly collaborative shared technology environment that spans multiple teams or projects.
 Ability to interpret the needs of creative and less technical team members, translating design visions into clear technical requirements.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across time zones and multicultural environments.
 Nice to Have :
(please note these skills are not required to apply) Familiarity with Unreal Engine architecture.
 Understanding of multiplayer network architecture and client-server synchronization for game state/quests. 
 Shipped AAA game(s) on a bespoke or custom narrative/quest toolset.
 Familiarity with Unreal Engine UI tools or editor scripting for custom content tools.
